scenes.heading: Scheduling
scenes.narration: Scheduling controls when your jobs run, whether on a fixed cadence, a cron expression, or in response to file arrival.

scenes.heading: Ways to trigger a job
scenes.narration: A cron schedule runs a job at precise times, such as every morning at two. Interval or continuous triggers keep pipelines running on a rhythm. And file-arrival triggers start a job only when new data lands, avoiding wasted empty runs.

scenes.heading: Getting schedules right
scenes.narration: Always set the correct time zone so jobs fire when you expect. Prevent a slow run from overlapping the next scheduled start, which can cause conflicts. And align the schedule with when upstream data is actually ready, not just the clock.

scenes.text: Prefer file-arrival or trigger-based schedules over fixed times when data timing varies, to save cost and avoid empty runs.
